character: Maximo (4h Checkpoint C; canon locked 2026-10-06): an elderly human, Kariaston's founder and its watchman over the Hollows; Karias was his apprentice. Theatrical and grand, and grieving underneath. In the world he is always in his blue armour (the Knight on foot); here, his face: bald and white-browed, a grand curled moustache and a goatee, a blue breastplate, a confident mouth.
